## Background

I'm Dr Stephen J Newhouse — BSc (Hons), MSc, PhD. My career has bridged **academic biomedical research** and **applied data science**, with a focus on extracting useful signal from biological and clinical data.

Past affiliations include the **NIHR Biomedical Research Centre for Mental Health at King's College London** and **King's Health Partners Bioinformatics Core**. I've co-authored peer-reviewed work in genomics, neurology, psychiatry, and translational medicine, and contributed to open-source tools and teaching materials used by researchers around the world.

## Expertise

- **Bioinformatics:** NGS analysis, variant calling, RNA-seq, GWAS, multi-omics integration
- **Data science / ML:** predictive modelling, biomarker discovery, model evaluation, MLOps
- **Statistics & genetics:** biostatistics, statistical genetics, population genetics
- **Engineering:** reproducible pipelines (Snakemake / Nextflow), containers, cloud (AWS/GCP/Azure)
- **Agentic AI:** memory architectures, retrieval, tool-use, LLM evaluation
- **Open science:** version control, reproducible research, teaching

## Current focus

- Agentic AI — see [aa-ma-forge](https://github.com/snewhouse/aa-ma-forge): an Advanced Agentic Memory Architecture
- Genetics & bioinformatics tooling — curating [awesome-genetics-software](https://github.com/snewhouse/awesome-genetics-software)
- Writing and sharing what I learn — see [blog](posts.qmd)
